depiction.primary_object: circle outline containing a centered solid filled circle

readings.meaning: record button (audio, video, or screen recording)
current location dot or center point

ambiguity: Without red color, it is identical to a selected radio button UI control, and looks very similar to a simple bullseye target, a CD/vinyl disc, or a task checkbox inside a to-do list.
task_intents: record a voice memo or podcast
record a musical track or demo
set up automatic call or meeting recording
hit a specific target or goal

reasoning: In monochrome, a circle with a solid center dot looks like a selected radio button UI control rather than a record button (which relies on red color) or a target (which needs multiple rings or crosshairs). In a to-do list, it heavily conflicts with task checkboxes and status indicators, and specific media icons (microphone, video camera) are always clearer for recording tasks.
